title: 5-Day Northern Morocco Tour: Fez & Chefchaouen
metaDescription: Explore Fez, Meknes and Chefchaouen in five days on a northern Morocco journey through historic medinas, imperial heritage and the famous Blue City.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 5-Day Fez & Chefchaouen Tour stays entirely in northern Morocco, making it a practical choice for travelers who want historic cities without adding a long journey to the Sahara. Explore the medina of Fez before continuing to Meknes and into the Rif Mountains for Chefchaouen, known for its blue-painted streets and hillside setting. Rabat and Casablanca bring the route toward Morocco’s Atlantic side for the final stage.
All intercity travel is handled privately, with departures possible throughout the year. Selected hotels, breakfast and dinner as specified, local guides, airport transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing form part of the five-day journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Fez
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Fès–Saïss Airport and meet with our representative. Transfer to your hotel in Fez.
Check-in after 14:00pm. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Fez Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Full-day guided tour of Fez, the spiritual capital of Morocco. Explore the Medieval Medina, traditional souks, and historic landmarks. Visit the Bou Inania Madrasa or Attarine Medersa, Nejjarine Fountain, and see the exterior of the University of al-Qarawiyyin Mosque. Afternoon visit of Fes el-Jdid (New Fez). Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Fez - Meknes - Moulay Driss - Ouazzane - Chefchaouen (220km)
itinerary.text: Drive to Meknes and enjoy an orientation city tour of the Ismailian capital. Continue through Moulay Idriss Zerhoun, the holy city, with optional lunch along the route. Proceed to Ouazzane before continuing to Chefchaouen in the Rif Mountains. Explore the famous blue-washed medina, narrow alleys, and traditional souks. Overnight in Chefchaouen.

itinerary.title: Chefchaouen - Ouazzane - Rabat - Casablanca (350km)
itinerary.text: Drive to Kenitra via Ouazzane. Continue to Rabat, the administrative capital of Morocco. Optional lunch at a local restaurant. Visit the Royal Palace of Rabat (Mechouar), Kasbah of the Udayas and its gardens, and the Hassan Tower Mosque. Continue to Casablanca. Overnight in Casablanca.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Casablanca Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Casablanca
Check-out and transfer according to your flight schedule
Transfer to Mohammed V International Airport for departure flight

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 5-Day Morocco Blue City Tour?
faqs.a: The 5-Day Morocco Blue City Tour covers Fez, Meknes, and Chefchaouen. This itinerary combines Morocco's rich imperial heritage with the stunning beauty of the famous Blue City, offering travelers a memorable journey through history, culture, architecture, and scenic mountain landscapes. The tour runs for 4 nights and 5 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 5-Day Morocco Blue City Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,075 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and transfers according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the entire journey. Comfortable vehicles are used for all transfers and sightseeing, ensuring a relaxing and convenient travel experience.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels and traditional Moroccan riads with daily breakfast. Properties are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and authentic Moroccan atmosphere.

faqs.q: Does the tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide fascinating insights into Morocco's history, culture, architecture, and local traditions throughout the trip.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors seeking a shorter itinerary focused on northern Morocco's most famous cultural and scenic destinations. It offers an excellent introduction to Morocco's imperial cities and mountain towns.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through medinas, cobbled streets, markets, and hillside neighborhoods. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Fez, Meknes, and Chefchaouen?
faqs.a: Fez is renowned for its UNESCO-listed medieval medina, traditional tanneries, and artisan workshops. Meknes is famous for its grand gates, historic palaces, and imperial heritage. Chefchaouen, known as the Blue City, captivates visitors with its blue-painted streets, charming atmosphere, mountain scenery, and excellent photography opportunities.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 5-Day Morocco Blue City Tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 5-Day Morocco Blue City Tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade accommodations, include Rabat or Casablanca, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
